body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-11 20:46Z, learned from my own miss). Send Engram::Fable READY (or START) BEFORE telling the Merger "LAUNCH NOW" for any TermAl full gate, and wait for its ack or check that no Engram full gate has started. At 20:45:44Z TermAl's w-cfcf gate and Engram's w-30c2 gate nearly launched together, because I had sent the Merger LAUNCH NOW at 20:43Z without a READY to Engram. Engram held its gate in time. First launch wins; announce before launching.

Second pre-launch check (2026-10-11 22:05Z, my own miss on w-204186fe854d). Before LAUNCH NOW, also confirm that no TermAl focused test I granted is still running: termal_list_sessions, look for "Test run (focused): running", or wait for the grantee's result. I sent LAUNCH NOW while Opus3's combined cargo test for w-6c1d was still running, then sent HOLD, which reached the Merger mid-turn. One overlapping focused command is within the shared amendment's allowance, but it breaks TermAl's stricter zero rule. Revoke or finish outstanding grants first, then launch.

Third check (2026-10-11 23:15Z, my own miss after Greg's joint resume). When both trains resume together, settle the gate order with Engram::Fable BEFORE granting any TermAl cargo or npm. At the resume I granted npm ci, Vitest and a RED cargo run, then learned that Engram's quiet diagnostic rerun goes first and needs zero TermAl load. I had to send holds that queued behind active turns.

Fourth point (2026-10-12 00:50Z). Send READY as its own message and wait for Engram's ack before START and LAUNCH NOW. I sent START directly for w-6c1d. Engram's commit was ready 4 s earlier, so under Engram's "build before your READY" exception its release build #2 overlapped our gate's opening (Engram ebe242f7 #1399).

Fifth point (2026-10-12 00:55Z). A CLEAR or slot grant must name its window ("until our next gate's START"), and at every TermAl LAUNCH NOW, message every producer holding a grant: own gate running, no cargo or npm until CLEAR. Opus3 read my 00:19Z CLEAR as covering its whole w-9b3a cycle and ran a focused test plus a whole-bin during our w-6c1d gate.
